headline: Federasi Futsal Indonesia Schedules Extraordinary Congress For Dec
seoTitle: Federasi Futsal Indonesia Schedules Extraordinary Congress
metaDescription: The Indonesian Futsal Federation has officially set its Extraordinary Congress for December 11, 2026, amid ongoing internal conflicts with PSSI.
aiSummaryBullets: The acting head of the Indonesian Futsal Federation (FFI) announced the Extraordinary Congress will be held on December 11, 2026.
FFI submitted its request for the upcoming congress to PSSI, the national football governing body.
Regional futsal associations have expressed support for the FFI's previous decision to report PSSI officials to the ethics committee.
aiContextParagraph: The internal leadership dispute involving the Indonesian Futsal Federation (FFI) and the Football Association of Indonesia (PSSI) continues to develop. Tensions escalated after FFI reported PSSI figures, including Erick Thohir and Yunus Nusi, to the PSSI Ethics Committee regarding the issuance of a decree concerning leadership changes. Critics, including Michael Sianipar, have contested the legality of PSSI's intervention and the subsequent appointment of an acting FFI head, arguing that any change in leadership must strictly follow the federation's Extraordinary Congress (KLB) procedures as outlined in its statutes. While some regional futsal associations have voiced their support for the FFI's formal complaint and urged for adherence to established bylaws, the FFI leadership has now officially scheduled a congress for December 11, 2026, to address the ongoing structural transition.
whyItIsViral: The event is gaining attention due to coverage by four independent outlets and a steady pace of reporting regarding the high-profile administrative dispute.
